The '''Berea system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berea]].
